content.text: Digital creators in regions like Nigeria or Venezuela face substantial challenges with conventional payment platforms like Stripe or PayPal. These restrictions hinder their ability to automate the delivery of digital products effectively. Google Apps Script offers a powerful solution to streamline digital commerce automation, allowing creators to deploy a sovereign [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-24|architecture]] that facilitates order fulfillment without reliance on traditional payment systems.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting language that allows you to automate tasks across Google products. In the context of digital commerce, it enables creators to set up [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-19|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-18|Automated Digital]] workflows that handle order processing and product delivery seamlessly. This automation is crucial for digital creators who operate in environments where payment platforms are either unavailable or heavily restricted. By leveraging Google Apps Script, creators can ensure that their customers receive digital products immediately upon payment confirmation, thereby enhancing user experience and operational efficiency.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A correctly configured sovereign stack using Google Apps Script can process orders in under 30 seconds. This efficiency is largely due to the integration of NOWPayments, which verifies crypto payments and triggers webhook events. When a payment is confirmed, the webhook communicates with Google Apps Script to initiate the order fulfillment process. This streamlined architecture allows for quick and reliable digital product delivery, without the bottlenecks often caused by traditional payment processing systems.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment solutions fail. Whether selling ebooks, courses, or software, these creators require an automated system that can handle payments and deliveries without manual intervention. Google Apps Script, combined with NOWPayments, provides an accessible method for these individuals to maintain full control over their transactions and data, allowing them to focus on creating rather than managing logistics.
Process orders in under 30 seconds with a properly configured stack.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective functioning of this architecture relies on several key components. Google Apps Script acts as the backbone for automation, while NOWPayments processes crypto payments securely. Cloudflare Workers can handle incoming webhook requests, ensuring that the system can manage a high volume of events—up to 100,000 per day on the free tier. Supabase or Google Sheets serves as the order storage solution, providing a reliable database for tracking purchases, while delivery emails can be managed through Resend or Gmail, facilitating instant communication with customers.

This stack provides a comprehensive setup with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, enabling you to deploy your store within 48 hours. Next, configure your Google Apps Script to interact with NOWPayments and manage your order fulfillment process. Finally, ensure that your delivery system is set up through Resend or Gmail for efficient communication. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore available products and get started.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital delivery works through a specific technical sequence that eliminates every manual step. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain for incoming transactions to your configured wallet address. When a transaction receives the configured number of on-chain confirmations — typically one confirmation on Tron, which takes under 60 seconds — NOWPayments sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App receives this request, validates the webhook signature against the secret key you configured, reads the payment data, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your database, and sends the delivery email with a time-limited download link.
Cloudflare Workers can handle 100,000 webhook events daily, ensuring scalability.

This post connects with searches for automated digital delivery and webhook integration, showcasing how the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) effectively combines these elements. By using Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, creators can automate their sales processes efficiently. For more details, check out https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your backend first — Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible via HTTP POST before configuring NOWPayments. Set the IPN webhook URL in your NOWPayments account settings to point to your backend endpoint. Set the IPN secret key in both NOWPayments and your backend configuration — this is the string that both sides use to verify webhook authenticity. Upload your product files to the configured delivery storage — Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive — with the paths matching your backend configuration. Complete a real mainnet transaction and check your backend logs to confirm the webhook was received, the signature was validated, the transaction was verified on-chain, the order was logged, and the delivery email was sent. Monitor the order database daily for the first week.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery occurs when a payment is confirmed via NOWPayments. The system uses a webhook to trigger Google Apps Script, which processes the order and sends the product to the customer instantly, eliminating manual steps.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is an automated message sent from one application to another when a specified event occurs, such as a payment confirmation. In digital commerce, it triggers the fulfillment process, notifying Google Apps Script to deliver the purchased product.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?

Yes, once a crypto payment is confirmed, the system can automatically send download links using Google Apps Script. The webhook from NOWPayments initiates this process, ensuring customers receive their products promptly.
How do I ensure reliable order storage?

Using Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage ensures that your transactions are securely logged and easily accessible. Both solutions provide an efficient way to manage orders without the complications of traditional databases.
What are the benefits of using Google Apps Script for digital commerce?

Google Apps Script offers flexibility, ease of integration, and cost-effectiveness. It automates repetitive tasks, reduces manual errors, and enables seamless interactions between payment processing and product delivery.
Full control over your infrastructure means no subscription fees or platform dependence.
